POSITION OBJECTIVE
  
  
Reporting to the Director of Education Abroad, the Education Abroad Systems and Data Analyst serves as the functional systems and data expert for the Office of Education Abroad. This position is responsible for the administration, maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of Terra Dotta and related systems and processes that support education abroad programs and services. This position works collaboratively with education abroad staff and campus stakeholders to ensure that systems, data, workflows, and business processes effectively support program administration, student services, financial processes, institutional reporting, and a high-quality user experience. The systems and data analyst translates operational needs into effective system and process solutions, maintains data integrity, monitors system interfaces and processes, develops reports and documentation, and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, accessibility, and service delivery.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Serve as the primary functional administrator and subject matter expert for Terra Dotta within the office of education abroad. Maintain and configure program records, application workflows, forms, questionnaires, requirements, communications, permissions, and other system components supporting education abroad programs and services. Responsible for overseeing independent academic travel and non-credit bearing student travel requirements for risk management purposes. Monitor system functionality and data quality and troubleshoot issues in collaboration with Terra Dotta and Utech. Monitor Terra Dotta system updates and new functionality; participate in release webinars, review release documentation, test new features, and recommend and implement system enhancements that improve office operations and the student experience. Develop and maintain system documentation, standard operating procedures, and user resources. Provide training and support to office of education abroad staff and campus users. (40%)
* Maintain the accuracy and integrity of education abroad data across Terra Dotta and Case Western Reserve University systems. Monitor and reconcile data between Terra Dotta and the Student Information System (SIS), investigate discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with campus partners. Monitor education abroad course registration and enrollment data and resolve discrepancies with office of education abroad staff, the Registrar, academic departments, and other campus partners to resolve discrepancies. Administer and maintain the financial components of Terra Dotta, including program fees, deposits, refunds, scholarships, and related student financial information. Support risk management processes through Terra Dotta by maintaining and monitoring required application components, risk-related questionnaires and documentation, and student participation data, certificates of insurance, and other risk-management records. Monitor risk-related data and requirements to identify incomplete, inconsistent, or missing information and coordinate resolution with appropriate office of education abroad staff and campus partners. (25%)
* Develop, maintain, and produce reports and data sets for the office of education abroad, university administrators, and external reporting requirements, including the annual Open Doors Report. Maintain systems and accurate records for education abroad scholarship recipients, awards, and related program and student information and produce reports to support institutional reporting, assessment, planning, and analysis. Develop and maintain Tableau dashboards and data visualizations to communicate education abroad participation, program, scholarship, and other institutional data. Monitor data trends and identify inconsistencies or opportunities to improve data quality, reporting, and decision-making. (15%)
* Analyze education abroad systems and administrative processes to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, accessibility, compliance, and the student experience. Develop and implement improved workflows, procedures, and user resources based on operational needs and stakeholder feedback. Provide troubleshooting, training, and guidance to office of education abroad staff, students, faculty, and campus partners. Collaborate with University Technology, registrar, Institutional Research, Financial Aid, Student Financial Services/Bursar, Risk Management, Student Conduct, academic departments, and other partners on systems and process initiatives. (15%)

**Nonessential Functions**
Perform other duties as assigned. (5%)
  
  
CONTACTS
  
  
Department: Work with all departmental staff members on a daily basis to exchange information.
  
  
University: Regular contact with Academic and Four-Year Advisors and other faculty and staff across campus. Frequent contact with University Technology Services, the Office of the Registrar, Institutional Research, Student Financial Services/Bursar, Financial Aid, Student Conduct, and the Office of Risk Management to exchange information.
  
  
External: Frequent contact with Terra Dotta and regular contact with other education abroad technology vendors or partners as needed to exchange information.
  
  
Student: Frequent contact with students regarding independent academic travel and non-credit bearing programs.
  
  
**Supervisory Responsibilities**
This position does not supervise employees.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Experience: 1 to 3 years of relevant work experience required. Experience working with databases, enterprise systems, data management, or administrative systems preferred. Experience in international higher education or education abroad preferred. Experience with Terra Dotta or a comparable education abroad management system preferred.
  
  
Education: Bachelor's degree required.
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Demonstrated experience administering and optimizing databases, enterprise systems, and technology-based administrative processes; translating business and operational requirements into effective system configurations, workflows, processes, and solutions; analyzing, reconciling, validating, and reporting data from multiple systems; and maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

**Description**
Mosaic is a leading North American Integrated Marketing Agency, specialized in connecting with consumers through Experiential Marketing, B2B, Sales & Merchandising, and Shopper Marketing. At Mosaic, we are never satisfied with the status quo and are in constant search for new ideas and new ways to help our clients build their brands amidst the evolving dynamics of empowered consumers and leveraging new technologies.
  
  
The Client Data Analyst II (analyst) position is responsible for partnering with our clients and teams to drive their initiatives with strategy, analytics and actionable insights, optimizing program measurement to drive field team success, and constantly engaging with the team to better understand where they can have the greatest impact. The analyst will leverage business and market relevant information to make data-driven decisions that allow Mosaic to achieve its sales and marketing objectives and quickly adapt tactics. The analyst will play a key role in evolving, leading, and growing the data-driven discipline within the program they support.
  
  
**The Incumbent(s) in this position should exhibit the following values:**

* People Minded – Must show dignity and respect to all people
* Integrity – Must exemplify the highest degree of ethical behavior
* Results Oriented – Must show passion, pride and commitment to succeed
* Trust – Must be honest, sincere and confident
* Teamwork – Must build trusting relationships
* Innovation – Must progress through a combination of creativity, common sense and vision
* Balance – Must maintain an optimistic attitude and keep perspective on what is important in life

**Responsibilities**

* Apply advanced statistical methods to analyze complex datasets, identify business drivers, and develop actionable recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders.
* Lead the development and evolution of measurement frameworks, KPIs, and analytical methodologies to evaluate program performance and business outcomes.
* Design, execute, and interpret quantitative research studies, including market testing, A/B testing, multivariate experiments, and quasi-experimental analyses.
* Build and validate statistical models to understand customer behavior, sales performance, promotional effectiveness, and other key business questions.
* Conduct hypothesis testing, regression analysis, forecasting, segmentation, and other advanced analytical techniques to support strategic decision-making.
* Translate analytical findings into compelling business narratives, communicating insights, risks, assumptions, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Partner with clients and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for optimization and develop data-driven go-to-market strategies.
* Stay current on analytical best practices, emerging statistical methodologies, consumer insights research, and industry trends.
* Collect, integrate, cleanse, transform, and validate large, complex datasets from multiple sources while ensuring data quality and integrity.
* Develop reproducible analytical workflows and documentation to support ongoing measurement, research, and reporting initiatives.
* Participate in client meetings, internal strategy sessions, and occasional field ride-alongs to maintain a strong understanding of program operations and business objectives.
* Utilize statistical and analytical software such as Python, R, SQL, and visualization tools to conduct analyses and communicate results.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Analytics, Market Research, or a related quantitative field.
* 3-5 years of experience in analytics, consumer insights, market research, data science, or a related quantitative role.
* Demonstrated experience applying statistical methods to solve business problems and influence decision-making.
* Experience designing and analyzing experiments, including A/B testing, test/control methodologies, multivariate testing, or other research designs.
* Strong understanding of statistical concepts including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sampling methodologies, significance testing, regression analysis, and model validation.
* Proficiency in Python, R, SPSS, or other statistical software for data analysis, modeling, and research applications.
* Intermediate to advanced SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
* Experience with predictive analytics, forecasting, segmentation, driver analysis, or other advanced modeling techniques preferred.
* Strong data preparation skills, including data cleaning, transformation, validation, and quality assurance.
* Ability to translate complex analytical findings into actionable business recommendations and communicate results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience developing measurement frameworks, KPIs, and analytical methodologies to evaluate business performance.
* Strong analytical thinking, intellectual curiosity, and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify meaningful insights within large datasets.
* Experience managing multiple projects and delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced and often ambiguous environment.
* Intermediate to advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis functions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or other visualization tools for communicating insights and analytical results.
* Remain informed on emerging analytical methodologies, market research techniques, consumer behavior trends, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to learn the business, understand client objectives, and identify new opportunities for measurement, analytics, and strategic insights.

We are seeking an experienced Research Engineer to join the System Safety team within Product & Applied Research org at Meta Superintelligence Labs. This role will focus on researching and developing advanced machine learning models, novel algorithms, and scalable systems that improve the safety of Meta's AI products, including Meta AI and conversational, multimodal, and agentic experiences.You will bring current AI safety research into practical product safeguards, with a primary focus on guardrails, policy-adaptable risk detection, adversarial robustness, and safe agent behavior. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with end-to-end ownership of a significant safety area—from setting research direction and developing methods through rigorous evaluation, cross-team integration, and continuous improvement in production.
  
  
Research Engineer - AI Safety Systems and Guardrails Responsibilities:
  
  

* Research and develop state-of-the-art machine learning models and novel algorithms for AI safety, with a primary focus on guardrails, risk detection, policy adherence, and adversarial robustness
* Design, prototype, and implement safety systems for language models, multimodal models, and AI agents, addressing harmful assistance, jailbreaks, prompt injection, unsafe tool use, and unauthorized information disclosure across individual interactions and complete agent tasks
* Set the technical direction and research roadmap for a significant system safety area, leading complex initiatives across research, alignment, evaluation, product, and infrastructure teams
* Architect and optimize reusable safety components and machine learning pipelines, combining learned detection with explicit runtime controls and delivering scalable, low-latency safeguards for real-world applications
* Develop high-quality training data, synthetic and adversarial examples, and representative benign cases
* conduct rigorous experimentation, ablation studies, and independent held-out evaluation to improve safety, generalization, and robustness
* Measure the effectiveness of safeguards within the fully deployed system, balancing risk reduction with false refusals, legitimate task completion, privacy, latency, cost, and reliability
* Collaborate closely with model researchers, product managers, engineers, and evaluation, security, and policy partners to translate product needs and safety requirements into validated, production-ready solutions
* Monitor, maintain, and iterate on deployed safety models and systems, using approved data and privacy-preserving workflows to identify emerging failure patterns, create regression tests, and drive lasting system or model improvements
* Stay at the forefront of research and industry trends in AI safety, LLMs, multimodal modeling, adversarial robustness, and agentic systems
* reproduce, critically evaluate, and extend promising methods for product deployment. Mentor engineers and researchers to influence architecture and research decisions, and communicate findings through technical documentation, internal presentations, and external publications where appropriate

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Proven track record of research in one or more of the following areas: AI safety, deep learning, adversarial robustness, language models, multimodal machine learning, or agentic AI, demonstrated through original or materially improved methods and rigorous experimental evidence
* 3+ years of experience in deploying machine learning models and systems at scale in an industry setting
* Demonstrated up-to-date expertise in relevant machine learning research advancements, including the ability to reproduce, critically evaluate, and adapt emerging methods to real-world systems
* Hands-on programming experience in Python and deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, including developing, training or fine-tuning, debugging, and evaluating machine learning models
* Demonstrated experience independently defining technical direction and leading complex research or machine learning initiatives end-to-end, aligning multiple teams and delivering measurable product or platform impact
* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts, influence cross-functional technical decisions, and mentor engineers or researchers

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience developing AI safety guardrails, policy-adaptable classifiers, reliable model-based judges, or adversarial defenses for deployed AI systems
* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related technical field, or equivalent advanced research experience
* Expertise in safety data generation, adversarial evaluation, calibration, or in multilingual and multimodal safety modeling
* Experience with agent safety, prompt-injection defense, multi-turn risk detection, tool-use controls, or security-informed threat modeling
* A strong record of relevant research contributions, such as peer-reviewed publications, adopted open-source methods, or widely used systems supported by rigorous evaluation
* Experience with efficient model inference, distillation, cascaded models, or distributed ML systems under latency, throughput, cost, and reliability constraints

**Job Summary:**
Our client is seeking customer experience (CX) Data Analyst Consultant to help transform customer, agent, and business research into actionable strategic insights that inform enterprise priorities and business decision-making.
  
This role will support the democratization of insights across the enterprise by creating clear, actionable data products that can be utilized by leaders across the business.
  
The ideal candidate combines data visualization skills, data science skills, an understanding of storytelling with data, and clear communication skills. They bring curiosity and diligence to address roadblocks and adapt to evolving technologies.
  
This is a contract consulting opportunity with the potential to convert to a full-time position in 2027, subject to business needs and applicable approvals.
  
  
**About the role:**
Our client is advancing an enterprise-wide effort to modernize how client, agent, and field leadership feedback is collected, synthesized, and activated across the business. Through a centralized insights approach, we are connecting research, feedback, and operational intelligence to provide business leaders with a clearer understanding of customer and agent needs, prioritize opportunities, and accelerate decision-making.
  
As a CX Data Analyst Consultant on the Insights team, you will play a critical role in translating this growing body of intelligence into meaningful business impact.
  
You will partner with experience strategy, research, analytics, technology, and business stakeholders to develop visualizations synthesizing multiple data sources across multiple platforms.
  
Rather than conducting research in isolation, you will focus on making research actionable. You will work across quantitative and qualitative studies, customer and agent feedback, operational metrics, and existing research repositories to develop integrated visualization that provide leaders with deeper understanding about the state of the business.
  
This role requires intellectual curiosity, strong business judgment, and the ability to work with speed and independence. You must be comfortable working with large sets of data, both structured and unstructured, to build reports in a dashboard, with an understanding of how to use AI as a force multiplier. A bonus will be a candidate that is familiar with customer feedback data ranging from surveys to call transcripts.
  
The successful candidate will bring a data-driven approach to problem-solving, data storytelling skills, and a demonstrated ability to build a scalable dashboard program.

**Develop powerful dashboards**

* Collect feedback from business stakeholders to design the dashboard
* Translate business requirements into intuitive, meaningful, and actionable visualizations.
* Apply data visualization best practices to communicate complex information clearly and effectively.
* Develop calculations, filters, and interactive features that enable users to explore and interpret data.
* Test functionality, identify and resolve issues.
* Optimize dashboard functionality, usability, accessibility, and performance.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to refine dashboard requirements and incorporate user feedback.

**Data Gathering and Integration**

* Identify, access, and retrieve relevant data from multiple internal and external sources.
* Understand enterprise data structures, source systems, and data relationships.
* Integrate information from disparate sources to create comprehensive and consistent datasets.
* Evaluate data availability, reliability, completeness, and suitability for reporting and analysis.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to identify data requirements and resolve data accessibility challenges.

**Data Preparation and Transformation**

* Clean, standardize, and transform survey and unstructured data into structured, analysis-ready datasets.
* Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicates, missing values, and formatting issues.
* Combine, aggregate, and organize datasets to support reporting and analytical requirements.
* Develop and maintain repeatable data preparation and transformation processes.
* Apply data modeling principles to ensure accuracy, consistency, and efficient reporting.
* Document data transformation logic, business rules, and data definitions.

**Data Analysis and Interpretation**

* Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, relationships, and actionable insights.
* Apply analytical and statistical techniques to identify anomalies, performance drivers, and opportunities for improvement.
* Translate business questions into analytical approaches and measurable outcomes.
* Communicate analytical findings and recommendations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

**Data Refresh, Automation, and Maintenance**

* Develop and maintain processes to ensure dashboard data is updated accurately, consistently, and on schedule.
* Monitor refresh schedules and reporting processes to ensure reliability and availability.
* Troubleshoot data connectivity, processing, and refresh issues.
* Maintain and enhance existing dashboards as business requirements, data sources, and reporting needs evolve.

**Data Quality, Validation, and Governance**

* Establish and execute data validation and reconciliation procedures to ensure reporting accuracy.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies between source data and dashboard outputs.
* Apply established data governance, security, and access management standards.
* Maintain consistent metric definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
* Document data sources, processing logic, dependencies, and quality controls.
* Partner with data owners and stakeholders to address data quality concerns and improve confidence in reported information.

**Business Requirements and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, operational processes, and strategic objectives.
* Gather, document, and translate business requirements into technical and analytical specifications.
* Recommend appropriate metrics, reporting structures, and visualizations based on business needs.
* Present analytical insights and dashboard functionality to stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise.
* Manage enhancements, prioritize requests, and support continuous improvement of reporting capabilities.
* Provide user guidance and support to encourage effective adoption of dashboards and analytical tools.

**Preferred Skills:**

* At least three years of professional experience in data visualization and data science, ideally within financial services or another complex, regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop clear dashboards, supported by data pipelines.
* Experience in Tableau, scripting languages such as R, Python, SQL. Ideally a candidate is familiar with Qualtrics
* Detail-oriented approach to development and testing of dashboards, and other data products.
* Exceptional written and oral communication and executive storytelling skills, with demonstrated experience creating strategic presentations, executive briefings, and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly understand complex business models, customer relationships, distribution channels, and operational dynamics.
* Proficiency with AI-powered tools and technologies to accelerate research, synthesize complex information, identify actionable insights, and enhance efficiency, with a strong emphasis on critical evaluation and accuracy.
* Strong proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel, including the ability to create polished, executive-ready presentations and interpret quantitative analyses.
* Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, prioritize competing requests, and deliver high-quality work at speed.

**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara's Commercial Customer Success team supports hundreds of customers who depend on our platform every day to manage their fleets, equipment, and operations. These customers don't just need software — they need a partner who helps them get to value fast, identifies and mitigates risk, and keeps finding new ways to put Samsara to work for their business.

We're building the AI infrastructure to make that possible at scale. And we need an applied AI specialist to build it — and own it.

As an embedded AI Engineer in Customer Success, you'll design, build, test, deploy, and continuously maintain agentic solutions that power this next chapter. You'll own the full lifecycle: from the first prompt through production, from launch through every iteration as our Customer Success playbooks evolve, and as our product ships new features and real-world performance data surfaces what needs to change next. The agents you build will only be as good as the care you put into keeping them relevant and reliable over time.

**This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US**
**except**
**the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.**

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:**

  Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
* **You thrive the most when solving problems:**

  Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
* **You are a natural relationship builder:**

  Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
* **You are the architect of your own career:**

  If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You want to be with the best:**

  At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

**Your core responsibility is the full lifecycle of Samsara's customer-facing AI agents
  
  
**In this role, you will:****

* **Build:**
  Design agent architectures, write prompts, integrate with external systems (Salesforce, Samsara platform, Customer Success tools), and write clean Python code that the team can maintain.
* **Test:**
  Define success criteria and evaluation frameworks before you write the first line of code. Build automated test suites that cover real-world scenarios, edge cases, and known failure modes.
* **Deploy:**
  Own the deployment, versioning, and rollback plan for every agent. Ensure agents are production-ready before they reach CSMs or customers.
* **Monitor:**
  Track agent performance in production — monitor accuracy, latency, failure rates, and customer outcomes. Detect drift before anyone has to tell you something's wrong.
* **Maintain & Iterate:**
  Update agents continuously as Samsara's product evolves, Customer Success playbooks change, and real-world data indicates what needs improvement.
* **Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles**
  (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH
  
  
In your first 30 days**

* Embed with the Commercial Customer Success team to understand what Customer Success Managers actually do — their workflows, their friction points, and the customer moments that move the needle
* Get fluent in Samsara's platform, data model, and existing Customer Success tooling stack
* Define success metrics and an evaluation framework for the first agent on the roadmap — before you write a single line of code

**In your first 90 days**

* Ship the first production agentic solution that meaningfully improves customer outcomes that lead to revenue retention and/or growth
* Build the monitoring and iteration loop from day one — so you have a clear signal on what's working, what's drifting, and what needs to change
* Spec the second agentic solution to detect and mitigate risk within accounts and start building, applying lessons from the first
* Provide an estimated start date for the value gap detection and product consultation — identifies underutilization and leads product consultations via text or call.

**By the end of your first year**

* Own a portfolio of three or more production agentic solutions running reliably in the Commercial Customer Success motion — and a clear maintenance cadence that keeps them current as the product and playbooks evolve
* Demonstrate the impact of agentic solutions on reduced customer time to value, reduced time spent detecting and resolving risks, and increased retention
* Have a track record of improving solutions after launch: performance improvements measured in real customer outcomes, not just benchmark scores
* Be the go-to expert at Samsara for customer-facing agentic AI development — advising Customer Success leadership on what to build next, what to retire, and how to evaluate ideas before committing to them
* Help define what great looks like for ing at Samsara, setting a standard others can build on towards using AI to expand the pipeline

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* Hands-on experience building and maintaining production LLM-based agents or automations
* Python proficiency and a track record of connecting AI to external systems: CRMs, APIs, customer data, and operational tools
* The discipline to define what success looks like before you start building — and an eval framework that catches problems before your users do
* A genuine curiosity about Customer Success workflows and customer problems, not just the technical challenge
* Intellectual honesty about what AI can and can't do well — and the judgment to design guardrails and fallback paths accordingly
* 3+ years of software engineering or technical experience, with at least 1 year working hands-on with LLMs or AI agents in a production environment
* Experience in a B2B SaaS environment

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Direct experience with Anthropic Claude or similar LLM APIs
* A background working with or alongside a Customer Success or Revenue Operations team
* Experience building regression test suites or eval frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar CRM and Customer Success platforms

**WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW**

* **You'll be first:**
  This function doesn't exist yet. You'll define the role, the standard, and the playbook for ing in Customer Success
* **The problem is real:**
  A Customer Success Manager managing 350+ accounts can't do everything manually. AI agents aren't a nice-to-have — they're what makes this motion sustainable at Samsara's scale.
* **The timing is right:**
  The models have caught up to the use cases. Samsara has the customer data, the platform context, and the Customer Success team to make these agents genuinely powerful.

 The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\) NX Platforms team owns the packet processing pipeline running beneath every EC2 instance — adding encryption, firewalls (security groups), routing, billing, and monitoring to every packet on every host across our worldwide fleet of 9M\+ hosts in more than 30 regions.
